dedupe_keys.name: pypsa at austrian sector coupled energy model

description: PyPSA-AT adapts PyPSA-Eur to model Austria's electricity and other energy carriers in one sector-coupled optimisation. Its maintainers publish the code, documentation and examples for electricity, gas, hydrogen, biomass, heat and transport-related fuels. Users supply Austrian assets, demand, renewable profiles, technology costs and scenario assumptions. Outputs are capacities, dispatch and energy flows for the selected planning horizon and spatial and temporal resolution. Geographic coverage is Austria, with external links determined by the case. The original code is publicly available under MIT terms; inherited components and input datasets may carry separate terms. The README warns that the project is in active early development and asks users to cite the exact code and input-data versions. A limitation is that methods and interfaces can change rapidly and users must inspect the published limitations for each research question. PyPSA-AT supports national transition and capacity studies. The catalogue's model-pypsa-eur is its broader European parent. No Austrian data or scenario was run.
name: PyPSA-AT Austrian sector-coupled energy model
